stories.title: Woman's death case referred up after police probe
stories.summary: Izabela Chalastra's death will now be looked at by a regional review unit, it has been confirmed.

stories.title: Plaques placed on homes to bring war stories to life
stories.summary: One woman with a plaque dedicated to a 29-year-old soldier says she is 'proud' he lived at her house.

stories.title: Men jailed for false imprisonment after kidnap
stories.summary: Muhammed Kah, Zafar Dormant and Nathan Vilarinho, from London, were seen bundling a man into a car.

stories.title: MP backs town's proposed balaclava ban
stories.summary: It would follow restrictions on some face coverings brought in by Nottingham in September.

stories.title: Woman's first go at CPR saves partner's life
stories.summary: Sophie Bettles helped restart Jack Dennis's heart and saved his life before paramedics arrived.

stories.title: The fans at the foggy FA Cup game no-one could see
stories.summary: Thick fog left Notts County fans unable to see parts of the Magpies' FA Cup win over Altrincham.

stories.title: Tram services resume after derelict pub fire
stories.summary: Four engines and an aerial ladder platform were sent to the blaze, firefighters say.

stories.title: EMR warns of 'extremely busy' weekend due to works
stories.summary: The rail operator says it is advising customers to only travel "if essential" on 28 and 29 November.

stories.title: Man who tried to kill partner with hammer jailed
stories.summary: Shaquel Kerr's victim suffered a bleed on the brain and fractures to her skull, face and spine.

stories.title: Trees snapped by vandals at country park
stories.summary: Nottingham City Council says the incident has been reported to Nottinghamshire Police.

stories.title: Park home owners want 'unfair' selling fee scrapped
stories.summary: Park home owners say the 10% commission on home sales makes them feel like second-class citizens.

stories.title: Trams withdrawn due to 'major communications issue'
stories.summary: Nottingham Express Transit says it is unable to communicate with its trams due to a fault.
